about.title: About
about.text: For me, web development is the ideal intersection of logical architecture and tangible value. Driven by my technical background, I strive to write code that is not just functional, but well-thought-out, maintainable, and modular. I draw inspiration from the continuous evolution of modern technologies and the challenge of turning complex workflows into intuitive, high-performance web applications.
about.cta: Let's connect and create something amazing together!

list.location: Based in the Stuttgart area. I prefer working in a hybrid setup, bring dependable self-organization to the table, and value purposeful on-site collaboration.
list.learning: I quickly get up to speed with modern frameworks and tools, dig deep into underlying concepts, and continuously expand my skill set in a structured way.
list.problem-solving: I tackle challenges methodically and with perseverance: first understanding the root cause, then designing a clean, maintainable architecture. In doing so, I combine analytical precision with an eye for user-friendly, well-crafted UI design.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Throughout my projects, I have worked hands-on with modern HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript, building scalable web applications with frameworks like Angular. For me, development never stops at the basics: with web technologies moving fast, I actively expand my knowledge, prioritize clean architecture, and continuously adopt new tools and best practices.
skills.subtext: Technology never stands still—and neither do I. If your tech stack requires a specific technology or a new framework, I am driven and eager to master it thoroughly.

btn-learning.name: Continually learning
btn-learning.text: I have a special interest in learning

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

projects.pollo-loco: Jump, run and throw game based on object-orientated approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
projects.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
projects.pokedex: Based on the PokéAPI a simple library that provides and catalogues pokemon information.

roberz.text: You can trust Ana with any project, as long as you don't ask if it's running. If you ask whether it looks good, you'll get a twenty-minute, enthusiastic answer. On the plus side, she reliably solves problems—especially the ones nobody asked her to.

kids.text: Mom's screen is glowing all colorful, but nothing is happening. Turbo cool! But the chicken game was the Turbo Coolest. And now: playground?

ai.text: Working with Ana means turning a good idea into an even better result. She thinks creatively, finds solutions you wouldn't have thought of yourself, and only occasionally gets lost in a tiny detail that, naturally, turned out to be important after all.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Got a problem to solve?
contact.description: I help you turn ideas into clean, performant, and user-friendly web applications. Whether you are looking to strengthen your frontend team or need support building modern web projects—let's connect for an informal chat.
